description.text: Educational target: to cultivate practical highly qualified practitioner of Oral Medicine with knowledge of preclinical/clinical medicine, mastering basic theories, knowledge skills of Oral Medicine being able to engage in diagnosis treatment of common oral diseases / frequently-occurring diseases corresponding prevention work etc.Major courses：Basic Medicine, Clinical Medicine, Oral Pathology, Oral Anatomy Physiology, Oral Materials science, Oral Radiology, Orthodontics, Endodontics, Periodontics, oral medicine, oral maxillofacial surgery, Prosthodontics, Preventive Dentistry, Pediatric Dentistry, Medicine Related Method Humanistic Science.Basic length of schooling: 5 years.Degree to be granted: Bachelor of Dentistry

duration.text: The Stomatology at Guangxi Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program)Level 3 or above6. Health certificate(optional)Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Applicants shall be age 18-30 with good health condition and graduated from High School. English, Physics, Chemistry Biology reaches 70 points above.HSK level 4 or above.
